page.title: Settings
page.description: Company profile, localization and contact details

profile.title: Company
profile.description: Your business details, shown to renters and on invoices.
profile.name: Company name
profile.legalNameHelp: Your registered business name, if it differs. Shown on invoices.
profile.taxIdHelp: VAT, EIN or other tax number. Shown on invoices.
profile.subdomainHelp: Where renters see your fleet and book. Links you've already shared stop working if you change it.
profile.aboutPlaceholder: Family-run rentals in Miami since 1998, with free airport pickup.
profile.aboutHelp: Shown on your fleet site. Up to {{max}} characters.

localization.title: Localization
localization.description: Where you operate, your local time, and the currency renters pay in.
localization.currencyLocked: Can't be changed once you have bookings, so their prices keep their currency.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: How renters reach you. Shown on invoices and receipts.

social.title: Social links
social.description: Your username on each network. Leave any you don't use blank.

ownerOnly.title: Only the owner can change company settings
ownerOnly.description: Ask the account owner to update the company profile, contact details or social links.

images.title: Logo and banner
images.description: Shown at the top of your fleet site.
images.bannerHelp: A wide photo, 1600 px or more
images.drop: Drop an image here, or click to choose one
images.replaceHint: Click or drop an image to replace
images.invalidType: Use a JPG, PNG, WebP, HEIC or AVIF image.

style.title: Colors and headline
style.description: Your fleet site's colors, and the line over your banner.
style.headline: Headline
style.headlineHelp: Shown over your banner. Leave it blank to show your company name.

preview.title: Live preview
preview.note: Updates as you edit. This is how your fleet site will look to renters.

page.title: Users
page.description: Invite people to your company and choose what each of them can do.

ownerOnly.title: Only owners can see the team
ownerOnly.description: Ask an owner of the account to invite people or change their roles.

members.title: Team
members.description: Everyone who can sign in to this company, and what their role lets them do.
members.lastOwner: A company needs at least one owner. Make someone else an owner first.

invite.title: Invite someone
invite.description: They get an email with a link. They sign in or sign up with this address to join.

roles.owner: Everything, including settings, billing and the team
roles.manager: Runs the fleet, bookings, refunds and branches
roles.staff: Works the counter: bookings, customers and handovers

errors.already_member: This person is already on your team.
errors.invitation_pending: This address already has an invitation. Resend it from the list instead.

sent.title: Invitation sent
sent.emailed: We emailed an invitation to {{email}}. You can also send them the link yourself.
sent.notEmailed: Email isn't set up, so nothing was sent to {{email}}. Send them this link yourself.
sent.linkHelp: Works for 7 days, and only for that email address. You won't see this link again.
sent.copyFailed: Couldn't copy the link. Select it and copy it yourself.

pending.title: Pending invitations
pending.description: Sent, but not accepted yet. Resending creates a new link and the old one stops working.

revoke.title: Revoke this invitation?
revoke.description: The link sent to {{email}} will stop working.

remove.title: Remove {{name}}?
remove.description: They lose access straight away. What they did stays in the history under their name.
remove.selfDescription: You lose access to this company straight away. Another owner can invite you back.

stepDown.title: Stop being an owner?
stepDown.description: You'll lose access to settings, billing and the team straight away. Another owner can make you an owner again.

payments.sectionHelp: How renters pay you, and where the money goes.
payments.title: Payment processor
payments.description: Renters pay into your own Stripe account and Stripe pays out to your bank. Refunds, disputes and payouts are managed in your Stripe Dashboard.
payments.summary: Connect a Stripe account to take card payments and deposits from renters.

notice.unavailable: Stripe isn't configured on the server yet, so an account can't be connected. Add the Stripe keys to the API environment to switch this on.
notice.needsInfo: Stripe needs a few more details before it can turn on payments and payouts.
notice.pastDue: A deadline for some of Stripe's details has passed, so payments or payouts may be paused. Finish setup to restore them.
notice.inReview: Stripe is reviewing your details. Check back here, or use Check status.
notice.rejected: Stripe couldn't approve this account. Your Stripe Dashboard or Stripe support can tell you why.
notice.disconnected: Payments are off. Your Stripe account, balance and payouts are untouched; reconnect to take payments through it again.

payments.ownerOnly: Only the account owner can connect or finish setting up Stripe.

confirmDisconnect.title: Disconnect Stripe?
confirmDisconnect.description:
Veltrio will stop taking payments through this Stripe account.

The account stays yours, with its balance and payouts, and you can reconnect it at any time.

confirmNewAccount.title: Set up a different Stripe account?
confirmNewAccount.description:
You'll go to Stripe to set up a new account for Veltrio.

Your current account stays yours, with its balance and payouts, but Veltrio won't be able to reconnect it afterwards.

cancellation.title: Cancellation policy
cancellation.description: What a renter gets back when a booking is cancelled before pickup. Shown to renters before they pay.

none.label: No stated policy
none.hint: Decide each refund case by case. Renters are shown nothing.

flexible.label: Flexible
flexible.hint: Full refund up to 24 hours before pickup.

standard.label: Standard
standard.hint: Full refund 14 days out, half from 7 days.

custom.label: Custom
custom.hint: Set your own notice periods and refunds.

cancellation.customHint: From the longest notice to the shortest. Closer to pickup than the last tier, nothing is refunded.

problems.percent: Enter a whole percent, from 1 to 100.
problems.daysOrder: Notice must be shorter than in the tier above.
problems.percentOrder: The refund must be lower than in the tier above.

cancellation.appliesFrom: Applies to bookings made from now on: a booking keeps the policy it was made under. You still choose the refund each time you cancel one.

drivers.title: Additional drivers
drivers.description: Each driver besides the renter is billed this per rental day. Renters who add a driver on Veltrio are charged it; at the counter you can still change it per booking.
drivers.label: Price per driver
drivers.hint: Set 0 to add drivers for free. Some states, such as California, don't allow a fee for the renter's spouse: set that driver to 0 on the booking.
drivers.invalid: Enter an amount of 0 or more, to the cent.

billing.sectionHelp: Your Veltrio plan and what it covers.
billing.title: Your plan
billing.description: Plans are sized by the vehicles and branches you run. Every plan has the same features.

notice.off: Billing isn't switched on for this workspace, so nothing is limited.
notice.noneTrial: Choose a plan to start your {{days}}-day free trial. Until then you can't add vehicles, take bookings or run checks.
notice.none: Choose a plan to add vehicles, take bookings and run checks.
notice.trialing: Your free trial ends on {{date}}. Your card is charged then unless you cancel.
notice.pastDue: Your last payment didn't go through. Update your card to keep your plan.
notice.ending: Your plan ends on {{date}}. After that you can't add vehicles, take bookings or run checks.
notice.ended: Your plan has ended. Choose a plan to add vehicles, take bookings and run checks again.
notice.onHold: Your plan is on hold because a payment didn't go through. Update your card under Manage billing to carry on.

actions.manageHelp: Update your card, see invoices or cancel

tooSmall.vehicles: You have {{have}} vehicles. {{plan}} allows up to {{limit}}.

billing.ownerOnly: Only the account owner can choose or change the plan.

confirmChange.description:
{{plan}} costs {{price}}, billed {{period}}.

The change takes effect now, and Stripe charges or credits the difference for the rest of this billing period.

banner.owner: Choose a plan to add vehicles, take bookings and run checks.
banner.other: This workspace has no active plan. Ask the account owner to choose one.
banner.pastDue: Your last payment didn't go through. Update your card to keep your plan.

credits.sectionHelp: Prepaid credits for background and insurance checks.
credits.title: Verification credits
credits.description: A check takes its credits when you run it. They come back if it never gives an answer.

level.empty: Not enough credits to run a check.
level.low: Running low. Buy more or switch on auto-recharge.

credits.needsPlan: Choose a plan before buying credits.
credits.ownerOnly: Only the account owner can buy credits.

buyDialog.title: Buy credits
buyDialog.description: Credits never expire. You pay on Stripe's secure page.

autoRecharge.title: Auto-recharge
autoRecharge.on: Buys {{credits}} credits when fewer than {{below}} are left
autoRecharge.dialogDescription: When the balance falls below the number you choose, a pack is bought on the card your plan is paid with. If the card can't be charged, auto-recharge switches off and you get an email.
autoRecharge.buysNow: You have fewer than {{below}} credits now, so this pack ({{price}}) is bought as soon as you save.

history.sectionHelp: What Veltrio has charged you, with each invoice.
history.title: Billing history
history.description: Your plan's charges and credit purchases, newest first.
history.emptyDescription: Your first invoice appears here once your plan is charged or you buy credits.
history.more: Older invoices are under Manage billing.

description.vehicles_one: Your {{plan}} plan covers up to {{count}} vehicle. Upgrade it to add more, or archive one you no longer rent out.
description.vehicles_other: Your {{plan}} plan covers up to {{count}} vehicles. Upgrade it to add more, or archive one you no longer rent out.
description.branches_one: Your {{plan}} plan covers {{count}} branch. Upgrade it to add more, or delete one you no longer use.
description.branches_other: Your {{plan}} plan covers {{count}} branches. Upgrade it to add more, or delete one you no longer use.
description.noPlan: Vehicles and branches can be added once your workspace has a running plan.
description.onHold: A payment didn't go through. Update your card under Manage billing to add vehicles and branches again.

limit.ownerOnly: Only the account owner can change the plan.
